name: Bahamas Hot Mix Co
primary_cta: Project atlas on screen 1 (real Bahamas map, projects counted by island, category filter) with a quote router that names the office (Nassau, Freeport, Marsh Harbour) and emails it
brand_truth: BHM makes its own asphalt and concrete, tests it in its own accredited labs and takes the plant to the island, which is why its runways run from Nassau to a cay in the Exumas.
buyer: Procurement and project managers at ministries, the airport authority, resort and cruise developers, engineering consultants; homeowners for small paving.

direction.type: T04 Technical mono (Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono for real data only)
direction.why: Procurement buyers trust order and evidence; a hairline grid with runway designators and ISO numbers lets their own drone photography be the only spectacle. Salt grey ground, petrol accent from the water, one asphalt field for materials.

concept_type: brochure: approach-to-land hero, runways explorer, inward chapter (roads, ports, water), materials, certification, filterable project atlas (66 projects, own page), quote desk by office

pitch_line: Your Hog Cay runway is one of the most beautiful construction photos in the Caribbean, and your website shows it at 400 pixels. This opens on it, full screen, and turns a procurement visit into a routed quote request.
assumptions: Project categories on the atlas were assigned from project names (their site filters by category but the scrape did not show each project category); confirm.
Grand Bahama International and Marsh Harbour and Bimini rows say Runway works: the exact scope per airport to confirm.
Quote desk routing by island to the three offices is our proposal; all three share one phone and email today.
